goal: Premium AI-first UI reference library; retrieval by dominant aesthetics, substyles, faceted visual tokens and curator rules

families.label: Structured
families.scope: Disciplined composition, clear hierarchy, typographic systems, and refinement.

families.label: Radical
families.scope: Rawness, deliberate friction, and challenges to digital-design conventions.

families.label: Graphic
families.scope: Expressive cultural graphic languages applied as interface systems.

families.label: Playful
families.scope: Playful, expressive graphic languages with a strong formal identity.

families.label: Retro Digital
families.scope: Historical computing, multimedia edutainment, and reinterpretations of retro digital technologies.

families.label: Millennium
families.scope: Turn-of-the-millennium technological futures and visual languages with contemporary creative potential.

families.label: Web Culture
families.scope: Visual codes developed in Internet-native communities and subcultures.

families.label: Futurist
families.scope: Speculative technological worlds with distinctive iconography, interfaces, and materials.

families.label: Uncanny
families.scope: Dreamlike, uncanny, and impossible worlds used as interface visual grammars.

families.label: Organic
families.scope: Naturalistic and handcrafted languages of composition and illustration.

families.label: Material
families.scope: Systems in which material simulation dominates the appearance of controls and surfaces.

aesthetics.label: Minimalism
aesthetics.signature: Removal of ornament; essential structure and content; purposeful whitespace.
aesthetics.boundary_rule: If polished decoration adds nonessential sophistication, classify as Clean.
aesthetics.agent_guidance: Reduce the interface to what is necessary; do not equate large amounts of whitespace with minimalism.

aesthetics.label: Clean
aesthetics.signature: Balanced grid; understated surfaces; refined controls; strong visual clarity.
aesthetics.boundary_rule: Do not confuse with Minimalism or Swiss because a design uses a grid.
aesthetics.agent_guidance: Prioritize hierarchy, components, and product consistency.

aesthetics.label: Swiss
aesthetics.signature: Modular typographic system; rigorous alignment; scale ratios; grid-driven rhythm.
aesthetics.boundary_rule: Editorial may also use grids, but prioritizes narrative sequencing; Swiss prioritizes the system.
aesthetics.agent_guidance: Specify grid and typographic rules, not just sans-serif type.

aesthetics.label: Editorial
aesthetics.signature: Narrative hierarchy; covers, indexes, and reading; publication-like composition.
aesthetics.boundary_rule: A blog is not Editorial simply because it publishes articles; editorial art direction must shape the interface.
aesthetics.agent_guidance: Study the rhythm across cover, index, article, and navigation screens.

aesthetics.label: Quiet Luxury
aesthetics.signature: Precise typography; carefully curated imagery; measured pacing; subtle detail and exclusivity.
aesthetics.boundary_rule: Not synonymous with beige, expensive-looking websites, or Minimalism.
aesthetics.agent_guidance: Assess photographic treatment, pacing, and finely crafted components.

aesthetics.label: Utilitarian
aesthetics.signature: High information density; precision; monospaced type where useful; visible boundaries, tables, and code.
aesthetics.boundary_rule: A SaaS landing page with occasional monospaced text can still be Clean.
aesthetics.agent_guidance: Preserve affordances, states, data, and functional legibility.

aesthetics.label: Web Brutalism
aesthetics.signature: Exposed HTML structures and web conventions; raw hierarchy; little visual accommodation.
aesthetics.boundary_rule: Minimalism without rawness is not Brutalism.
aesthetics.agent_guidance: Look for sustained rawness throughout pages and navigation, not a single detail.

aesthetics.label: Neobrutalism
aesthetics.signature: Thick outlines; solid offset shadows; flat colors; emphatic box-based components.
aesthetics.boundary_rule: Web Brutalism does not require decorative blocks or hard shadows.
aesthetics.agent_guidance: Demonstrate forms, controls, and layouts, not merely striking calls to action.

aesthetics.label: Anti-Design
aesthetics.signature: Intentional violation of grid, hierarchy, and compositional conventions; controlled dissonance.
aesthetics.boundary_rule: Maximalism does not automatically subvert conventions; Brutalism can be highly ordered.
aesthetics.agent_guidance: Explain how intent and navigation remain coherent despite deliberate friction.

aesthetics.label: Digital Collage
aesthetics.signature: Layered cutouts; mixed photographic and typographic media; DIY editorial assembly.
aesthetics.boundary_rule: Grunge is defined by sustained material distress rather than layering alone.
aesthetics.agent_guidance: Extract assembly rules, stickers, overlaps, and component treatments.

aesthetics.label: Acid Rave
aesthetics.signature: Disruptive typography; aggressive color; distortion; club-culture references.
aesthetics.boundary_rule: Synthwave uses nocturnal 1980s iconography rather than contemporary acid graphics.
aesthetics.agent_guidance: Examine rhythmic navigation, hierarchy, typography, and motion.

aesthetics.label: Grunge
aesthetics.signature: Torn surfaces, noise, eroded ink, rough typography, and visibly distressed materials.
aesthetics.boundary_rule: Digital Collage can be crisp; Grunge applies systematic visual erosion.
aesthetics.agent_guidance: Ensure texture shapes the interface rather than merely serving as wallpaper.

aesthetics.label: Geometric Pop
aesthetics.signature: Flat geometric forms; bold color; repeated patterns; playful interaction.
aesthetics.boundary_rule: Colorful circles alone do not qualify; geometry must shape hierarchy and components.
aesthetics.agent_guidance: Capture rules for shape, scale, navigation, and animation.

aesthetics.label: Kawaii
aesthetics.signature: Expressive cuteness; characters, friendly icons, and soft shapes; playful rhythm.
aesthetics.boundary_rule: Mascot-led design without a consistent kawaii grammar remains an illustration attribute.
aesthetics.agent_guidance: Assess consistency across characters, controls, and microstates.

aesthetics.label: Tactile 3D
aesthetics.signature: Soft or toy-like volumes; manipulable 3D objects; studio lighting and tactile qualities.
aesthetics.boundary_rule: Spatial 3D refers to a navigation mode; Tactile 3D refers to a material visual language.
aesthetics.agent_guidance: Inspect objects, cursors, buttons, shadows, and response to input.

aesthetics.label: Terminal / CRT
aesthetics.signature: Character grid; prompts; cursors; monospaced type; console-like navigation.
aesthetics.boundary_rule: Utilitarian design with a code snippet is not necessarily Terminal.
aesthetics.agent_guidance: Reproduce console interactions and states, not merely a green backdrop.

aesthetics.label: Retro Desktop
aesthetics.signature: Windows, menus, dialogs, icons, and classic desktop shells.
aesthetics.boundary_rule: Webcore is based on personal web pages, not necessarily operating-system metaphors.
aesthetics.agent_guidance: Distinguish visual inspiration, historical software emulation, and reinterpretation.

aesthetics.label: Pixel / Arcade
aesthetics.signature: Structural pixels in lettering, icons, and controls; conventions derived from games.
aesthetics.boundary_rule: Pixel art appearing only in a hero image is a visual resource, not the dominant aesthetic.
aesthetics.agent_guidance: Seek pixel-based UI systems, menus, indexes, and feedback states.

aesthetics.label: Y2K Futurism
aesthetics.signature: Synthetic sheen; iridescence; techno CGI; futurist geometry circa 1997–2004.
aesthetics.boundary_rule: Metalheart favors explosive fractals; Vectorheart relies on hard-edged vector construction.
aesthetics.agent_guidance: Distinguish Y2K interface structure, chrome ornament, and navigation patterns.

aesthetics.label: Metalheart
aesthetics.signature: Fractal depth; metallic explosions and abstractions; digital typography.
aesthetics.boundary_rule: Do not confuse dominant fractal compositions with generic futuristic chrome.
aesthetics.agent_guidance: Prefer references with navigation systems beyond the splash screen.

aesthetics.label: Vectorheart
aesthetics.signature: Angular vector forms; industrial vocabulary; high-contrast typography; diagonals.
aesthetics.boundary_rule: Metalheart builds distorted abstract volume; Vectorheart emphasizes precise vector graphics.
aesthetics.agent_guidance: Extract alignment, dividers, navigation, and angular geometry.

aesthetics.label: Frutiger Aero
aesthetics.signature: Techno-naturalist optimism; glossy transparency; sky, water, foliage, and light.
aesthetics.boundary_rule: Glassmorphism does not require the nature/technology imaginary; Web 2.0 can be glossy without Aero.
aesthetics.agent_guidance: Do not classify every shiny shadow as Frutiger Aero.

aesthetics.label: Webcore
aesthetics.signature: Personalizable backgrounds; GIFs; hyperlinks; HTML modules; personal-web identity.
aesthetics.boundary_rule: Retro Desktop uses window metaphors; Webcore draws on the vernacular of web documents.
aesthetics.agent_guidance: Separate authentic Old Web conventions from a modern landing page with a couple of GIFs.

aesthetics.label: Scene / MySpace
aesthetics.signature: Customizable social profiles; emo/scene layering; icons, sparkle effects, mixed type, and modules.
aesthetics.boundary_rule: Webcore is broader; Scene has its own social and visual codes.
aesthetics.agent_guidance: Seek full profile pages or websites rather than fashion moodboards.

aesthetics.label: Vaporwave
aesthetics.signature: Nostalgia for digital consumer culture; retro leisure interfaces; pastel and corporate collage.
aesthetics.boundary_rule: Synthwave evokes nocturnal neon and retrofuturist driving; Vaporwave evokes consumer nostalgia.
aesthetics.agent_guidance: Require navigation or components that extend the scene's visual language.

aesthetics.label: Synthwave
aesthetics.signature: Nocturnal 1980s look; purple and pink neon; perspective-grid horizon; driving imagery.
aesthetics.boundary_rule: Cyberpunk builds a narrative urban dystopia; Vaporwave favors pastel consumer nostalgia.
aesthetics.agent_guidance: Do not classify a site solely because it has a purple gradient.

aesthetics.label: Cyberpunk
aesthetics.signature: Dystopian high-tech city; signage, neon, overlays, and industrial texture.
aesthetics.boundary_rule: Sci-Fi HUD presents instruments and data; Cyberpunk constructs a narrative world.
aesthetics.agent_guidance: Analyze controls within the designed world, not just urban imagery.

aesthetics.label: Sci-Fi HUD
aesthetics.signature: Speculative instrumentation; modular indicators; data grids; overlays.
aesthetics.boundary_rule: Cyberpunk does not necessarily have a distinctive instrumental control system.
aesthetics.agent_guidance: Require coherent or functional UI, not detached decorative HUD assets.

aesthetics.label: Hyperchrome
aesthetics.signature: Liquid chrome; synthetic biomorphic forms; refraction; reflective futurism.
aesthetics.boundary_rule: Y2K imagines the future around the year 2000; Hyperchrome uses a contemporary material-futurist language.
aesthetics.agent_guidance: Verify the chrome treatment remains coherent across navigation and components.

aesthetics.label: Dreamcore
aesthetics.signature: Dream logic, memory, and incongruent atmospheres; narrative or environmental navigation.
aesthetics.boundary_rule: Weirdcore creates semantic unease through displaced signals; Dreamcore follows oneiric logic.
aesthetics.agent_guidance: Require a navigable experience with its own system, not a photo collection.

aesthetics.label: Weirdcore
aesthetics.signature: Media uncanny; ambiguous signs; low-fidelity images; disorienting scales.
aesthetics.boundary_rule: Glitch refers to technical corruption; Weirdcore creates conceptual uncanniness.
aesthetics.agent_guidance: Seek navigation architecture and interactions that participate in the uncanny effect.

aesthetics.label: Surreal Digital
aesthetics.signature: Impossible objects; juxtaposition; shifts of scale and conceptual visual logic.
aesthetics.boundary_rule: Dreamcore evokes memory and sleep; Surreal Digital may be crisp, clean, and conceptual.
aesthetics.agent_guidance: Confirm that the impossible transformation is part of the user experience.

aesthetics.label: Warm Organic
aesthetics.signature: Natural materials; earth tones; warm typography; soft, expressive pacing.
aesthetics.boundary_rule: Quiet Luxury emphasizes exclusivity; Warm Organic emphasizes natural tactility and closeness.
aesthetics.agent_guidance: Exclude generic wellness pages whose only signals are beige and plant photos.

aesthetics.label: Botanical
aesthetics.signature: Botanical illustration; structural plant ornament; filigree and poetic composition.
aesthetics.boundary_rule: A flower in the hero section is not enough; botanical motifs must govern frames, typography, and navigation.
aesthetics.agent_guidance: Favor sustained ornamental systems, including their controls.

aesthetics.label: Skeuomorphic
aesthetics.signature: Controls inspired by physical objects; relief, texture, and light that communicate affordances.
aesthetics.boundary_rule: Tactile 3D can portray playful objects without a functional object metaphor.
aesthetics.agent_guidance: Require a consistent physical-object metaphor across screens and states.

aesthetics.label: Glassmorphism
aesthetics.signature: Translucent panels; layered depth; blur, refraction, and luminous edges.
aesthetics.boundary_rule: Frutiger Aero also requires a techno-naturalist optimistic worldview; glass is a cross-cutting material.
aesthetics.agent_guidance: Classify as primary only when glass organizes the system, not when a navbar is transparent.

aesthetics.label: Gen X Soft Club
aesthetics.signature: Grounded, urban turn-of-the-millennium futurism; softened city photography, muted greens and grays, signage typography, and open space.
aesthetics.boundary_rule: Unlike Y2K, it favors calm, metropolitan organic imagery over chrome, outer space, and techno CGI.
aesthetics.agent_guidance: Verify dominance across multiple screens, navigation, and components; return UI references only after editorial review.

aesthetics.label: Utopian Scholastic
aesthetics.signature: Encyclopedic photo collage; isolated objects, diagrams, classical serif type, and exploratory navigation inspired by 1990s edutainment.
aesthetics.boundary_rule: Unlike Vaporwave, it organizes discovery and learning rather than parody and nostalgia for digital consumption.
aesthetics.agent_guidance: Verify dominance across multiple screens, navigation, and components; return UI references only after editorial review.

aesthetics.label: McBling
aesthetics.signature: 2000s pop culture; glamorous ornament, sparkle, conspicuous luxury graphics, stickers, and exuberant type applied to commerce and social sites.
aesthetics.boundary_rule: Distinguish it from futurist Y2K and Scene/MySpace: it has its own commercial glam imaginary.
aesthetics.agent_guidance: Verify dominance across multiple screens, navigation, and components; return UI references only after editorial review.

aesthetics.label: Vectordelia
aesthetics.signature: Flat 2D vector compositions with curves, flourishes, flowers, and bright graphics characteristic of the 2000s.
aesthetics.boundary_rule: Do not confuse with Frutiger Aero, which foregrounds photography, transparency, and 3D/glass materials.
aesthetics.agent_guidance: Verify dominance across multiple screens, navigation, and components; return UI references only after editorial review.

aesthetics.label: Seapunk
aesthetics.signature: Aquatic retro Internet imagery: digital textures, turquoise, nautical 3D visuals, tropical collages, and Tumblr culture.
aesthetics.boundary_rule: Do not merge with Vaporwave merely because both are nostalgic; their origins and visual worlds differ.
aesthetics.agent_guidance: Verify dominance across multiple screens, navigation, and components; return UI references only after editorial review.

aesthetics.label: Solarpunk
aesthetics.signature: Optimistic eco-tech vision; green infrastructure; biomimetic illustration; digital systems depicting sustainable worlds.
aesthetics.boundary_rule: Green branding or plant photography is insufficient; the interface must articulate an ecofuturist world.
aesthetics.agent_guidance: Verify dominance across multiple screens, navigation, and components; return UI references only after editorial review.

aesthetics.label: Global Village Coffeehouse
aesthetics.signature: Warm, handmade 1990s aesthetic: earth tones, hand-drawn lines, paper, imperfect textures, and natural motifs.
aesthetics.boundary_rule: More specific than Warm Organic, with a recognizable historical, pictorial, and textural grammar.
aesthetics.agent_guidance: Verify dominance across multiple screens, navigation, and components; return UI references only after editorial review.

aesthetics.label: Superflat Pop
aesthetics.signature: Highly saturated, intentionally flat Japanese pop illustration; characters and dense geometric pop patterning.
aesthetics.boundary_rule: Not every kawaii image is Superflat; it requires expressive flatness across the visual system.
aesthetics.agent_guidance: Verify dominance across multiple screens, navigation, and components; return UI references only after editorial review.

aesthetics.label: Liminal / Backrooms
aesthetics.signature: Empty transitional spaces; disorienting framing; navigation that creates spatial tension without relying on monsters or glitch.
aesthetics.boundary_rule: Do not confuse with oneiric Dreamcore or digitally anomalous Weirdcore; empty spatiality is the main signifier.
aesthetics.agent_guidance: Verify dominance across multiple screens, navigation, and components; return UI references only after editorial review.

aesthetics.label: Kidcore
aesthetics.signature: Toy codes, childhood kitsch, and visual systems built from primary shapes, stickers, and exuberant color.
aesthetics.boundary_rule: Do not label any app made for children as Kidcore; deliberately nostalgic childhood codes must dominate.
aesthetics.agent_guidance: Verify dominance across multiple screens, navigation, and components; return UI references only after editorial review.

aesthetics.label: Expressive Illustration
aesthetics.signature: An interface whose visual and narrative system is built around distinctive authored illustration, rather than a decorative hero image.
aesthetics.boundary_rule: Do not confuse with Kawaii merely because characters appear or with Geometric Pop because illustrations are flat.
aesthetics.agent_guidance: Verify dominance across multiple screens, navigation, and components; return UI references only after editorial review.

aesthetics.label: Art Deco
aesthetics.signature: Symmetrical ornamental geometry, arches, stepped motifs, fine lines, and architectural rhythm.
aesthetics.boundary_rule: Not simply Quiet Luxury: decorative geometry also structures controls and layouts.
aesthetics.agent_guidance: Seek multi-screen UI references; extract layout, type, component, and motion rules; confirm aesthetic dominance.
aesthetics.example_to_audit: ERA — Vide Infra (case study; no aprobado como canon)

aesthetics.label: Constructivism
aesthetics.signature: Diagonals, asymmetric grids, photomontage, typographic blocks, and geometric tension.
aesthetics.boundary_rule: Unlike Swiss, it emphasizes propagandistic dynamism and expressive asymmetry.
aesthetics.agent_guidance: Seek multi-screen UI references; extract layout, type, component, and motion rules; confirm aesthetic dominance.
aesthetics.example_to_audit: Composition No. 24 — Vide Infra (case study; no aprobado como canon)

aesthetics.label: Plakatstil
aesthetics.signature: A single isolated hero object, flat colors, striking lettering, and reduced advertising composition.
aesthetics.boundary_rule: Neither generic Minimalism nor Swiss: it organizes the page like an object poster.
aesthetics.agent_guidance: Seek multi-screen UI references; extract layout, type, component, and motion rules; confirm aesthetic dominance.

aesthetics.label: Op Art
aesthetics.signature: Systematic optical patterns, geometric interference, moiré, vibration, and ambiguous depth.
aesthetics.boundary_rule: Do not mistake one isolated shader for an interface whose entire visual system is optical.
aesthetics.agent_guidance: Seek multi-screen UI references; extract layout, type, component, and motion rules; confirm aesthetic dominance.

aesthetics.label: Wacky Pomo
aesthetics.signature: Cartoonish postmodernism; rubbery forms, toy-like controls, distorted lettering, and visual humor.
aesthetics.boundary_rule: Not equivalent to Kidcore; its cartoonish postmodern grammar is more specific.
aesthetics.agent_guidance: Seek multi-screen UI references; extract layout, type, component, and motion rules; confirm aesthetic dominance.
aesthetics.example_to_audit: Nickelodeon 2000 — Web Design Museum (historical; not premium-approved)

aesthetics.label: Cassette Futurism
aesthetics.signature: Analog science fiction; CRT displays, physical panels, hardware instruments, and tangible signals.
aesthetics.boundary_rule: Not Retro Desktop (OS windows) or Sci-Fi HUD (holographic overlays).
aesthetics.agent_guidance: Seek multi-screen UI references; extract layout, type, component, and motion rules; confirm aesthetic dominance.
aesthetics.example_to_audit: Pip-Boy / Alien: Isolation (fictional UI; study its web adaptation)

aesthetics.label: Glossy Web 2.0
aesthetics.signature: Gel-like buttons; specular highlights; rounded corners; gradients, shine, and polished icons.
aesthetics.boundary_rule: Not equivalent to Frutiger Aero; its focus is control grammar, not techno-optimistic nature imagery.
aesthetics.agent_guidance: Seek multi-screen UI references; extract layout, type, component, and motion rules; confirm aesthetic dominance.

aesthetics.label: Glitch / Corrupted Media
aesthetics.signature: Deliberate digital corruption shaping typography, imagery, navigation, animation, and rhythm.
aesthetics.boundary_rule: A primary aesthetic only when corruption dominates multiple screens, not when a hover effect glitches.
aesthetics.agent_guidance: Seek multi-screen UI references; extract layout, type, component, and motion rules; confirm aesthetic dominance.

aesthetics.label: Biopunk
aesthetics.signature: Biotech interfaces featuring biomaterials, clinical signals, tissue, mutation, and organic instrumentation.
aesthetics.boundary_rule: Unlike Cyberpunk, it uses a laboratory and biotechnology grammar rather than urban neon.
aesthetics.agent_guidance: Seek multi-screen UI references; extract layout, type, component, and motion rules; confirm aesthetic dominance.

aesthetics.label: Silicon Dreams
aesthetics.signature: Primitive 1990s CGI; artificial 3D environments, surreal objects, and synthetic textures.
aesthetics.boundary_rule: Unlike Surreal Digital, it has a recognizable retro-CGI visual language.
aesthetics.agent_guidance: Seek multi-screen UI references; extract layout, type, component, and motion rules; confirm aesthetic dominance.

aesthetics.label: Art Nouveau
aesthetics.signature: Whiplash curves; vegetal ornaments; organic typography; framing and curvilinear composition.
aesthetics.boundary_rule: Not generic Romantic Botanical: Art Nouveau ornament forms a distinct formal system.
aesthetics.agent_guidance: Seek multi-screen UI references; extract layout, type, component, and motion rules; confirm aesthetic dominance.

aesthetics.label: Neumorphism
aesthetics.signature: Soft raised or recessed relief within a single material; dual shadows; continuous surfaces and pressed controls.
aesthetics.boundary_rule: Unlike Glassmorphism, it does not depend on transparency; unlike Claymorphism, it avoids prominent positive volume.
aesthetics.agent_guidance: Seek multi-screen UI references; extract layout, type, component, and motion rules; confirm aesthetic dominance.
aesthetics.example_to_audit: Split Payment / Neumorphic Music Player (conceptos previos)

aesthetics.label: Claymorphism
aesthetics.signature: Inflated, volumetric components; exaggerated radii; friendly colors; clay-like shading and tactility.
aesthetics.boundary_rule: Unlike Neumorphism, it uses visibly raised volume and more emphatically rounded forms.
aesthetics.agent_guidance: Seek multi-screen UI references; extract layout, type, component, and motion rules; confirm aesthetic dominance.

cross_collections.label: Net.art
cross_collections.rationale: Art created through the browser itself, using HTML and links; not a single visual grammar.

cross_collections.label: Demoscene
cross_collections.rationale: Procedural graphics, creative coding, and audiovisual demos; the technique is not a homogeneous visual aesthetic.

cross_collections.label: Afrofuturism
cross_collections.rationale: A multidisciplinary cultural movement that requires context and attribution; it must not be reduced to generic motifs.

decision_history.note: F.2 aesthetics are preserved editorial decisions; this selection has approved zero references.

source_path_note: Legacy source paths are retained as historical locators; English translations of the included F.2 and H records are in this package.
